title: Integrated Applied-ML Eval Playbook: Onboarding, Prompt Sets, Quantization, and Regression Triage
author: Maya Chen
content:
Summary

This playbook defines the integrated process for onboarding models into the eval harness, curating prompt sets and benchmarks, validating quantization profiles, and running an efficient regression triage. It is intended for Applied ML engineers, model owners, and platform engineers who operate the eval-harness and quality-guardrails.

Goals

- Provide a repeatable, auditable onboarding path for new model variants.
- Ensure prompt sets represent real customer workloads and regression vectors.
- Validate quantization profiles with measurable quality deltas and performance gains.
- Define a clear, fast regression triage and rollback process that minimizes customer impact.

Owners and Contacts

- Playbook owner: Maya Chen (Applied ML)
- Eval harness maintainers: eval-harness-team@redwood.ai (team alias)
- Quantization tooling: kernel-and-quant@redwood.ai
- On-call for regressions (pager): applied-ml-regression-oncall

Scope and Definitions

- Model: any model binary or container uploaded to model-catalog (hosted/dedicated/private).
- Variant: quantized, distilled, or architecture-modified build derived from a base model.
- Eval harness: the standardized runner that executes prompt sets, metrics collectors, and generates artifacts (logs, diffs, and reports).
- Regression: a statistically significant negative change on one or more guardrail metrics vs the baseline (see Thresholds).

High-level Process Overview

1) Pre-onboarding checks (owner: model owner)
   - Confirm model metadata populated in model-catalog (name, version, architecture, tokenizer, baseline-commit-id)
   - Add model to "candidate" group in eval-harness and tag with intended quantization profiles
   - Provide expected throughput and latency targets (P50/P95) and primary use-cases

2) Prompt set selection and curation (owner: applied-ml prompts owner)
   - Select three prompt sets: smoke (10-50 examples), core-workload (100-2,000 examples), adversarial/regression-suite (100-500 examples)
   - Ensure examples include: typical customer prompts, high-importance business flows, and previously observed failure modes
   - Document prompt provenance, redaction status, and coverage notes in the prompt-catalog YAML

3) Eval harness run (owner: eval-harness team)
   - Execute smoke tests on candidate model: success required for further validation
   - Execute core-workload with full metrics collection (accuracy/semantic metrics, token counts, latency histograms, memory/KV profile)
   - Execute regression-suite and produce delta report vs baseline

4) Quantization profile validation (owner: quantization tooling)
   - Run quantize+validate pipeline for each profile: int8, q4_0, q5_0 (example names)
   - Collect quality metrics (ROUGE, BLEU, embedding-similarity, perplexity as appropriate) and compute quality delta vs baseline
   - Collect perf metrics (tokens/s, GPU mem, P50/P95 latency) and compute perf uplift

5) Review and approval (owner: model owner + reviewers)
   - If quality delta within allowed threshold and perf uplift meets targets, mark profile "approved-for-serving" in model-catalog
   - If failing, escalate to regression triage

6) Deployment and monitoring (owner: platform + SRE)
   - Canary deploy to 1-5% traffic depending on customer risk profile
   - Monitor APM traces, per-route latency/cost breakdowns, and quality alerting tied to eval sets

Thresholds and Quality SLOs

- Smoke test: 100% pass on structural checks (tokenization, API surface, deterministic seeds)
- Quality SLOs (relative to model baseline):
  - Core workload: pass rate >= 95% (binary task thresholds) OR mean embedding-similarity drop <= 0.02 (for semantic tasks)
  - Regression-suite: any single test failing with delta >= 3% triggers automated triage
- Quantization allowable delta: mean quality degradation <= 2% for approved profiles; exceptional cases require product sign-off
- Latency/Throughput targets (customer/preset defaults): P50 <= 120ms, P95 <= 350ms on dedicated-GPU profile; tokens/sec uplift target >= 1.5x post-quantization

Automated Checks and Artifacts

Each eval-harness run must produce the following artifacts and store them in artifacts-storage under the model/version/run-id path:
- metrics.json (flat key-value metrics)
- per_example_diffs.csv (example id, baseline output, candidate output, diff-score)
- latency_histogram.json
- quantization-profile-report.yaml (profile metadata + perf/quality numbers)
- signed-approval.txt (empty file if human-approved)

Example metrics.json snippet (illustrative):
```
{
  "run_id": "2026-07-20-abc123",
  "baseline_model": "llama-2-13b:2026-06-01",
  "candidate_model": "llama-2-13b-q4_0:2026-07-19",
  "core_pass_rate": "0.962",
  "embed_mean_sim": "0.987",
  "quality_delta%": "-1.3",
  "p50_latency_ms": "102",
  "p95_latency_ms": "312"
}
```

Regression Triage Playbook (detailed steps)

1) Detection (automated)
   - Alert types: quality-drop, performance-regression, API-failure
   - Alert payload includes run-id, affected-test-ids, delta values, and links to artifacts

2) Immediate mitigation (within 15 minutes)
   - If degradation observed in production and severity=high, trigger rollback to previous stable variant and open sev ticket
   - If in CI/canary, quarantine the model variant (remove from autoscale/promotion pipelines) to stop further rollout

3) Triage (first 2 hours)
   - Triage lead (on-call Applied ML) reviews per_example_diffs.csv to categorize failure modes: tokenization, hallucination, truncation, numeric errors, safety flags
   - Re-run failing subset with deterministic seeds and increased logging to confirm reproducibility

4) Root-cause analysis (same day)
   - Compare quantization-profile-report and kernel logs to identify kernel/quantization mismatches
   - Run ablation tests: fallback to higher-precision profile (e.g., q5_0 -> int8) and compare deltas
   - Check for prompt-catalog drift or test-data leakage that could explain shifts

5) Remediation and verification (1-3 days)
   - Implement fix: adjust quantization parameters, retrain calibration, or patch tokenizer mapping as appropriate
   - Re-run full eval-harness for affected model/version and validate against thresholds

6) Postmortem / Preventive actions (within 2 weeks)
   - Create a postmortem doc including timeline, RCA, and follow-up actions with owners and due dates
   - Add new test cases to regression-suite to prevent recurrence

Rollout and Approval Criteria Matrix

- Approved-for-serving (auto): core_pass_rate >= 95% and quality_delta >= -1.5% and tokens/sec uplift >= 1.4x
- Requires product sign-off: core_pass_rate between 92% and 95% OR quality_delta between -1.5% and -2.5%
- Blocked: core_pass_rate < 92% OR quality_delta < -2.5% OR any safety-check failure

Operational Runbook Snippets

- How to run the eval-harness locally:
  1. git clone git@repo:redwood/eval-harness.git
  2. docker build -t eval-harness:local .
  3. ./scripts/run_eval.sh --model-path /mnt/models/candidate --prompt-set path/to/promptset.yaml --output /tmp/run-artifacts

- How to trigger quantization pipeline:
  - CLI: rq run quantize --model-id MODEL_ID --profile q4_0 --output /artifacts/model-quantized

- How to approve a profile in model-catalog:
  - ui: Open model page -> Profiles -> Approve -> add comment -> sign-off
  - API: curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"model_id":"MODEL_ID","profile":"q4_0","action":"approve"}' https://catalog.internal/api/v1/approve

Quality and Governance Notes

- All eval artifacts are retained for 90 days by default; high-risk customers may require 365-day retention (engage security/compliance)
- Any profile marked "restricted" must include a privacy rationale and legal review documented in related_pages
- Use the regression-suite CI gate: changes to prompt-catalog or eval-harness code must pass CI with no new regressions before merging

Appendix: Example prompt-catalog YAML entry
```
name: customer-chat-core-2026-07
owner: applied-ml-prompts
examples:
  - id: c-001
    source: prod-sanitized
    intent: clarification
    text: \"How do I change my billing email?\"
  - id: c-002
    source: partner-sim
    intent: refund
    text: \"I was charged twice, how do I get a refund?\"
```
